strings.en: We've built up quite a force now, haven't we?
If we can meet up with the rest, we'll have the whole lineup.
Grendizer and the Mazinger team... and the Nadesico group.
Any word from them?
Unfortunately, special jamming inside this planet as well
limits communication to a very narrow range...
The Nadesico should be advancing on the core data as well.
If we follow it too, we should be able to join up.
The Gandor is also steadily closing in on the matching data point...
If we meet no further resistance, we should make it in time.
I wonder if the Nadesico's okay... with that captain and all.
Daisuke's there too, right? No need to worry...
I hope Tetsuya and the others aren't doing anything reckless...
Daisuke's with them, so there's no need to worry about that, right?
Still, what bothers me are the mechs Shapiro brought with him...
What do you mean? Aren't they leftovers from the last war?
No, given their numbers... they can't be mere remnant forces...
That Fake Dancougar running wild outside never showed up last war...
Then... Muge Zorbados is behind it?
Yeah... that could be...
Sara...
Shapiro was alive... Why not that Muge bastard too?
It makes no difference. We've got bigger things to worry about now.
Kasshu is right... We have a mission that takes priority over all else...
Dirad, was it? This planet?
Is something like this really going to hit?
I've been calculating, and this planet's speed
is gradually increasing.
Wasn't it stopped just a while ago?
They meant to lure us in, but things got dicey,
so they started hurrying, huh...
Then we have to hurry even more.
Anyway, as long as the Nadesico gets to the core, it'll work out, right?
That's the plan... but even for Earth, to have to sacrifice the Nadesico...
Huh? Really?
...A planet-scale collapse. No one at the center would come out unharmed.
Prospector was in tears, too.
The Nadesico is a ship we'll need in the battles ahead... I won't allow that.
But they said it's the only way.
No, I have an idea...
But a better way than that... You don't mean, Commander...?
Not there yet, Yurika?
Ruri, how's it look?
We're close, but I can't pinpoint the location yet.
If we run into any more enemies, we may not reach the core in time.
That's right. We've made it this far because Captain Burning's group
is holding off the enemy, but...
If only the Gandor had come...
Things never go smoothly.
Anyway, nothing matters unless we get the Nadesico to the core, right?
Till then, I'll protect this Nadesico no matter what, I tell ya!
Hey, I just thought of something... If the worst happens,
how's everyone on the Nadesico gonna escape?
We can escape in our own robots...
but we can't carry everyone.
Hey, I just thought of something...
In an emergency, how would the Nadesico crew get out of here?
Naturally, there's an escape plan in place, I assume.
Don't worry. In the worst case, we have our onboard craft, the Hinagiku.
It might be a bit cramped, but we should be able to escape in it.
But Omoikane can't self-destruct... in other words, commit suicide.
...Someone would have to stay behind to do it, though.
Of cooourse, the only one staying is me, the captain!
Yurika!? You can't mean it!?
Hold on, Yurika! Are you trying to get yourself killed!?
It's okay, I won't die! I'll just escape in an Aestivalis.
Huh!? Hey, hey, an Aestivalis isn't that easy to...
Could it be, Captain, you've had the IFS treatment?
Ding-dong! Correct!
IFS...? What's that?
Image Feedback System...
It feeds the pilot's thoughts straight into the Aestivalis's movements.
With the treatment, even a cat could more or less move an Aestivalis.
...Paw pads.
You're gonna pilot an Aestivalis too?
That's right! Leave me either your Aestivalis or Yamada's, Akito.
Now the only question is whether we can carry it out in time...
I doubt the core will be free of enemies, though...
It'll be fine! We've got the invincible Mazinger team!
You ain't part of the Mazinger team, I tell ya.
In the worst case... we'll have to say goodbye to the Nadesico...
And that saves Earth! Isn't that a bargain!?
For Nergal, it's hardly a bargain... Ah, no, let's leave it at that.
So it's time.
What is it, Joe? Don't tell me... you're scared?
Don't be stupid.
I'm not dying till I settle things with that bastard Ilbora.
...What was that thing that looked like a black Tobikage, anyway?
Good question. All black, and giving off total villain vibes...
...Ilbora, damn him.
Everyone, we sortie soon. Hurry up with your machine adjustments.
Daisuke... Koji... Hang in there...!
Are they all right...? We can't reach them, can we?
They're fine. They're handling it.
Yes, those two would never make that kind of mistake.
The worse the odds, the stronger Koji gets. But...
Huh...?
The numbers will make it tough, no question.
...It'd be different if Tobikage had gone on ahead...
Daisuke... Tetsuya... Hang in there...!
Are they all right...? We can't reach them, can we?
They're fine. They're handling it.
...Those two would never make that kind of mistake, Sayaka. But...
But...?
The numbers are gonna make it tough, though.
...It'd sure help if that Tobikage went on ahead of us.
Tobikage, huh...
Tobikage... I don't really know much about it...
Oh, Tobikage's on our side.
On our side? What is it, exactly? Who's piloting it?
"Who," huh... That's a tough one, right, Big Bro?
Uhh... Well, anyway, it's definitely a reliable ally.
Well, that's about the size of it.
It helped us out at Jaburo, too.
Can it operate in space too?
Yeah, the first time we descended to Earth...
Tobikage's the one that helped us down.
Hope it helps us this time too... but counting on others isn't great.
In that sense, it's not very dependable.
Maybe it's surprisingly shy? Nah, probably not.
Hard to say. Seeing Blue Jet and Rom...
it doesn't sound entirely like a joke.
Yeah, you can't count on it like that. Geez, what a pain.
Maybe it's just shy?
Robots can't be shy, can they?
...Seeing Jet and Leina, I can't say that for sure.
Ugh... Agreed.
Machine people, aliens, people from other dimensions... anything goes.
Your hands have stopped! We sortie soon. It's now or never for tuning.
No time to slack off.
Shiro, don't be so on edge...
He seems quite fired up.
Yeah, yeah. ...After this asteroid, it's high time we unmasked it.
Keim, Abel...
Yes, Lady Diore... At last... our long-cherished wish...
...is about to come true.
Indeed... We shall soon reach the time of rooting...
We'll take Earth into our body, and the seeds of life, given soil,
and take form in the world...
Magnificent...
We are but a temporary form of the Dirad... The seeds of life
will wake from a 200-million-year sleep and take flesh once more.
The peaceful age of plants alone... this time, we will make it eternal.
Lady Diore, forgive my impertinence, but I must speak.
...Why was the rooting not achieved 200 million years ago?
Had the rooting been achieved back then...
the Earthlings would never have pushed in this far...
Keim, you forget yourself...!
The time was not yet ripe... in this universe...
for the Dirad was born too soon.
Born... too soon...?
Lady Diore, the ones that appeared before the Earthlings broke in...
those things of bones and tentacles... what are they?
Surely... they're not connected somehow?
They are allies of the Dirad.
They too wish for the Dirad to take root.
They aren't Dirad, and yet...
they wish for our peaceful age of plants alone?
Yes... What they need is us, the people of the Dirad.
The Earthlings are no longer needed.
(...No longer...? Then Lord Shapiro...)
...Lady Diore, intruders.
The ones from Earth, Abel?
Yes.
Impossible... They found this place!? Abel!
Yes. But their luck ends here. ...Lady Diore, I take my leave.
...The only obstacles left are those Earthlings...
You will go as well, Keim.
...Yes, my lady.
(If Earthlings are in her way, why did Lady Diore save Lord Shapiro?)
